stories.body:
Six years following Stripe's historic acquisition, Nigerian fintech leader Paystack is undergoing a strategic shift. According to reports from TechCabal published in October 2026, the company is altering its core business model.

Rather than solely focusing on moving money across digital channels, Paystack is now learning how to keep deposits. This pivot represents a major evolution for the platform.

The structural change is largely driven by the urgent need to survive ongoing currency devaluations. By retaining deposits rather than just passing funds through, the company aims to safeguard its financial standing.

As the African fintech ecosystem continues to mature under economic pressures, Paystack's adjustment highlights how major players are adapting their operations to navigate volatile macroeconomic environments.

Industry watchers will be closely monitoring how this deposit-focused approach shapes the company's trajectory and competitive edge in the coming years.
